name: The name in the record

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; remembered history predates the quest

summary: Returned to the dragon’s record, the story of the hilt resolves into a name: Quel’Delar, sister to Quel’Serrar. Its remembered history binds red dragonflight craft to the high elven crown and to a defender who stood before the Sunwell. The book does not make the sword’s inheritance simple. It tells how a gift can outlive a kingdom’s wound, while leaving its next bearer to be contested.
